currentPage.title: Easter Services at Life.Church
currentPage.seoDescription: Fix your eyes on hope this Easter at Life.Church.
currentPage.seoKeywords: Easter, Life.Church, Jesus, resurrection, life, truth, Way of Jesus, Christianity, hope, belief, kids, family, Craig Groeschel

01.headingText: When life feels heavy, where you look matters. This Easter, fix your eyes on Jesus—the One who endured the cross and offers hope for right now.

04.headingText: You’ll experience a welcoming environment, uplifting worship, and hear an encouraging message from Pastor Craig Groeschel.

04.content: Find an Easter service time by choosing a Life.Church location near you.

03.churchOnlineDesc: All online services are in US Central Time.

07.content:
Worship with your family and others around the world at Life.Church Online.

Saturday, April 4 – Saturday, April 11

01.headingText: Hope is meant to be shared. Someone in your life is looking for it, and your invitation could change everything.

00.content: Hi! Want to come to Easter at Life.Church with me? You can see the service times here—let me know what works for you! https://www.life.church/easter2026

0.title: Can I come to an Easter service if I don’t normally attend?

00.title: Do I need to RSVP or have a ticket to attend?
00.content: Nope! All our services are free, and no RSVP or ticket is required.

01.title: Is there childcare or something for kids?
01.content:
Yes! LifeKids is available for children birth–6th grade.

You can even pre-register your kids to make check-in easy when you arrive.

02.title: How early should I get to church before the service starts?
02.content: We recommend arriving 10–15 minutes early to give yourself time to check in your kids, grab a snack or coffee, and get settled.

03.content: You can attend Easter services at Life.Church Online or watch on YouTube, Facebook, or Instagram.
03.title: I don’t live near a Life.Church location. How can I attend online?
